positions.description:
▪ Designed and developed the SQL database tables and queries with PostgreSQL and MyBatis.
▪ Developed internal website to upgrade solution programs using Spring Boot, Thymeleaf, SlickGrid, AWS in the full development cycle from design, implementation, deployment, and testing.

positions.title: Project Management
positions.description:
▪ Provide general administrative support for the engineering and project management department. 
▪ Managed completion of punch list for BASF Acetylene Plant Construction Site

positions.title: Engineering & Project Management
positions.description:
▪ Coordinated electrical and automation projects, focusing on automation of production lines in various industries using Siemens PLC/HMI programming. 
▪ Support for completing engineering project objectives by reviewing project proposals and plans, quotes, Functional Design Specification (FDS) and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) protocols. 
▪ Created status reports, financial reporting, risks & issues associated with the project.
• Assisted in inquiring and ordering components from sub suppliers. 

⮚ Project Experience: 
▪ Siemens Croton Water Filtration Plant: Project coordination, standards and procedures development, and AutoCAD electrical drafting for $20MM water treatment facility project.
▪ Developed project execution plan, calculations, proposals and Tracked projects against schedule and budget for Knapp Automatic medicine distributing mechanism (C, Java, MySQL), Habasit Automated belt machines (SCADA), Stockmeier adding reactors to GE PLC (Cimplicity SCADA)

positions.title: IT/Data Management Intern
positions.description:

• Coordinated the project “Bike MS fundraising event“
